title: Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA)
summary: Describes the Edwards-curve Digital Signature Algorithm, a modern way to create and verify digital signatures. It gives parameters for the edwards25519 and edwards448 curves, with an example implementation and test vectors.

eli5.summary: A digital signature is like a stamp only you can make that anyone can check. EdDSA is a modern, fast stamp that is hard to forge.
